name: Hard slap past the crashing third baseman
why: A hard slap past a crashing corner, with the slapper's running start: the batter beats the throw. The summary says so; the throw to 1st is still the play.

name: Slap in the hole — shortstop backhand
why: The slap in the hole is designed to beat the throw; the summary says so.

name: Grounder to short, nobody on
why: 8U arms: the long throw from short often doesn't beat the batter. The summary says so.

name: Runner on 2nd — look them back
why: 8U arms, and the look-back costs a moment: the batter beats the throw. The summary says so.

name: Double play: runner on 1st, grounder to short
why: Turning two is hard on a 60 ft softball diamond and for 13-14 year olds on 90 ft: the lead out is made and the relay is a step late. The summary says so.
